components.css: .ds-index-list { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-index-list li { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 24px; padding: 14px 0; border-top: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #8d8d88 22%, transparent); } .ds-index-list li:last-child { border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #8d8d88 22%, transparent); } .ds-index-list a { color: var(--white, #f1f1ed); font-size: clamp(1.35rem, 1.2rem + 0.75vw, 1.8rem); line-height: 1.2; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: transparent; text-underline-offset: 0.18em; } .ds-index-list a:hover { text-decoration-color: currentColor; } .ds-index-list .ds-aside { margin-left: auto; font-family: var(--font-mono, ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace); font-size: 13px; color: var(--grey, #8d8d88); text-align: end; }

components.css: .ds-code-work { margin: 0; display: grid; place-items: center; background: var(--black, #080808); } .ds-code-work pre { margin: 0; padding: clamp(1.25rem, 4vw, 4rem); overflow-x: auto; max-inline-size: 100%; } .ds-code-work code { font-family: var(--font-mono, ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace); font-size: clamp(1.4rem, 5.5vw, 4.5rem); line-height: 1.2; white-space: pre; color: var(--white, #f1f1ed); }

narrative.overview: The homepage is completely black, and the works generate the visual variation. The site is not a portfolio but an exhibition space made from black, typography, moving image, images, diagrams, code, generated visual material, substantial conceptual writing, and empty space. The interface stays structurally constant while the artistic media change radically. The sophistication is meant to be invisible: no framework aesthetic, no decoration, no chrome that exists because websites normally have it. The black space is not unused space; it is part of the work.
keyCharacteristics: Monochrome interface; colour appears only when a work introduces it
Typography and spatial composition carry the entire visual identity
One thing at a time: one work on the stage, one column on the page
Real URLs and real text; effects never sacrifice addressability or access
Honest placeholders [ … ] instead of invented content

rules.name: The Artwork-Only Color Rule
rules.body: The interface is monochrome. Colour enters a screen only because an artwork carries it. Never tint the UI, never desaturate a work to match the UI.

rules.name: The Grey-Rests-White-Acts Rule
rules.body: Chrome rests in Whisper Grey and brightens to Warm White on hover; content links rest in Warm White and reveal an underline on hover. Two rules cover every interactive element on the site.

rules.name: The Typography-Is-Identity Rule
rules.body: No decoration may substitute for typographic composition. If a screen feels empty, the answer is scale, space, or placement — never an added element.

rules.name: The Flat Void Rule
rules.body: Any shadow, glow, or gradient on interface elements is a defect. The void has no light source.

dos: Do keep the interface to the three neutrals and let artworks supply colour.
Do give every work and practice a real, shareable URL.
Do use mono for code, data, imprints, counters, and measurement.
Do mark missing content with bracketed placeholders ([ … ]) in mono grey — honest gaps over invented prose.
Do keep media lazy: poster first, muted autoplay only, one video at a time, reduced-motion and save-data respected.
Do compose mobile intentionally (bottom bar, swipe, viewport media).
donts: Don't add cards, thumbnail grids, masonry, shadows, gradients, rounded rectangles, badges, or dashboard aesthetics.
Don't add hamburger menus, oversized navigation bars, or marketing typography.
Don't add decorative animation or gratuitous scroll effects; motion is the crossfade, the view-transition morph, and the works themselves.
Don't desaturate or frame artworks to match the interface.
Don't load trackers, analytics, webfonts, or third-party content beyond intentional PeerTube media.
Don't fill missing artistic content with generic placeholder prose.
